ReportType.description: Each detail row represents a Gift Transaction record that is directly related to an Account record. Only Gift Transactions with a non-null Donor Id are included in this dataset, even if all filters are removed from a given report. This configuration allows for reporting on Gift Transaction records in the report result details while applying a cross filter that starts from the Account object. Includes fields from Outreach Source Code, Payment Instrument, Matching Employer Transaction, Gift Commitment Schedule, Gift Commitment, Opportunity, Campaign, Donor (Account and Person Account > Contact), Account Owner, and Party Philanthropic Research Profile.
ReportType.label: Gift Transactions Related To Accounts
